review_scope: All 23 installed main and candidate pairs reviewed side by side for material and geometry continuity. Local highlight and shadow differences remain visible. The separate installed Saturday scene proves the changed route and dialogue.

images.observation: Floorboards, the near stove and the table legs remain distinct in the same view.
Tile joints remain readable through the warm beam beside the curtain.
Blind slats, floorboards, the seated-area woodwork and clothing read in both views.
Shelf, blind, desk and chair retain their geometry. The spot shifts slightly on the wall.
Cupboard, sink and piping stay visible. The light bloom changes along the plaster.
The boiler dial, panel joints and overhead copper rise remain visible.
Books, cabinet glass and the doorway hold their silhouette. Wall shadow softens in the candidate.
The tile grid, vertical line and cistern lip remain distinct. The candidate is slightly cooler behind the cistern.
Dark brick and mortar remain distinguishable at the same close stance.
The plate, circular terminals and conduit stay present. The wall behind them catches a warmer pool.
Dog silhouette, floor tiles and brass rail remain recognizable under the bar.
The cat, ledge and portrait remain in the same low spill.
Beam seams, portraits and the shelf retain their visible silhouettes.
Letter slots, labels and bench remain visible with only modest reflection changes.
Fins, curtain and the lamp-table contacts remain clear. The floor and near table change slightly in warmth.
Handrail, wooden floor and overhead conduit continue across the same landing.
Tank legs, roof seams and the skyline remain separated.
The green terminal glow, boards and plaque surfaces remain visible, with a brighter candidate floor patch.
Tile courses stay legible and the cistern and side line stay aligned. Candidate lamp contrast is lower on the far wall.
The coloured floor residue remains separate from the warm boards and radiator feet.
The upright growth and its wall contacts remain distinct in the lamp pool.
Kettle, toaster top and scattered crumbs remain readable. The wall shadow is weaker in the candidate.
Dial and housing stay visible. The wall receives a broader warm edge highlight.
